changelog:
- Initial release of the alphagbm-marks-cycle skill.
- Provides a single 0-100 cycle score combining VIX, SPY IV Rank, Put/Call ratio, and valuation percentile into a Howard Marks-style market cycle read.
- Returns both a quantitative cycle position and a plain-language offensive/defensive posture (e.g., NEUTRAL, OFFENSE, DEFENSE).
- Free, one-call API endpoint with 5-minute cache and no authentication.
- Exposes per-signal breakdown and mock data for development/testing.
